verdict.rationale: Skills can be committed to a repo: teams check in skills for a working folder, and Codex scans `.agents/skills` from the current directory up to the repo root. `$skill-installer` installs into your own local Codex setup, and the docs distinguish local from repo marketplaces as separate team-distribution sources. These pieces add up to project-local and user-level scopes, but the evidence never shows an explicit install-time scope choice for plugins. missing for 10: an explicit project-vs-user scope option when installing plugins, documented user-global install paths and precedence rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
